improvements.title: Invalid --mode values should error, not silently accept
improvements.description: Test 5 shows that --mode bogus does not error; it prints help with exit code 0. Expected: error message and non-zero exit.

divergences.title: Invalid --mode does not reject
divergences.expected: pi --mode bogus should error with exit code non-zero
divergences.impact: User may pass invalid modes without realizing; silent fallback to default mode
